results.title: Charlie Hunnam's Ed Gein Transformation: Platinum Silicone Chemistry and 30-Lb Fast
results.description: Charlie Hunnam Ed Gein transformation for Netflix's Emmy-nominated Monster series required platinum-cure silicone prosthetics, a 30-lb medically supervised fast, and vocal motor retraining -- three scientific disciplines that together reveal real materials chemistry and metabolic biology inside an acclaimed performance.
